Shortness of breath or difficulty breathing in a significant way—especially worse when lying down and better when I’m sitting up. I also have bouts of choking or shortness of breath that wake me up at night.

Doctor: When you wake up choking at night, do you also get chest pain, wheezing, or a cough (especially with frothy/pink sputum)?  
Doctor: Do you have leg swelling, rapid weight gain, or do you notice you can’t lie flat for long because of the breathing?

Yes—I've had heart failure and I also have swelling in one or more areas of my body (ankle and calf on both sides, and tibia on both sides). My symptoms are worse when lying down and alleviated while sitting up. I also have bouts of choking or shortness of breath that wake me up at night.

Doctor: Given you have known heart failure plus swelling and breathing that’s worse lying down, do you feel breathless with minimal activity or need extra pillows to sleep, and have you had weight gain over the last 1–2 weeks?
